completion_data.completion_summary: Added a sanctioned, count-only phase-marker grep recovery path to both orchestrate skills' Stage 5 missing/stale-handoff branches, with the exception carve-out prose in each SKILL.md and the reading-contract reconciled in handoff-schema.md and orchestrate-state-machine.md.

memory_candidates.content: Grep-based verification checks in a plan should specify exact case-sensitive substrings that both the source prose and the copied/adapted bash-comment block will actually contain byte-for-byte; when a block is deliberately copied across two variant files with only named adaptations (e.g. log prefix + one sentence), any pre-existing casing in the copied block's header must match the new prose's casing for a literal (non -i) grep count check to succeed.

When a plan's Phase N verification step scans a whole directory tree for a contradicting pattern (e.g. `grep -rn "NEVER reads" docs/ context/`), check for other occurrences of that pattern beyond the specific file(s) named in that phase's task list -- a phase-scoped fix can leave a sibling doc section with the same stale claim, which then fails the phase's own repo-wide verification even though the named tasks were completed correctly.

Under the git-workflow concurrency constraint (another implementation agent running on different files in the same repo), git status/diff will show files this agent never touched. Scope every git audit command (git diff --stat, task-reference grep, etc.) to this task's own declared file list rather than the whole tree, and document any unscoped discrepancy as a concurrency-attributable deviation rather than treating it as a defect.
